profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Thrilled to be at PiLogic building high precision AI for Satellites and Radar industries.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Our teams build innovative web and mobile solutions for industry leading Investment Professionals who collaborate to help millions of families all over the world realize their financial dreams. We are currently building a new platform and are actively hiring Software Engineers, and specialists in Data Science, and Machine Learning. Please reach out if you have demonstrated success in launching transformative web and mobile customer experiences or have built scalable Natural Language Understanding and Machine Learning solutions for Optimized Search experiences.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Led Engineering of Amazon Fashion (Softlines) Search User Experience

positions.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
positions.description: At Amazon, we aspire to make e-commerce and entire digital experiences are as frictionless as possible. I'm looking for talented and passionate engineers to help us build the best web and mobile apps for customers that trust and use our software.

positions.title: Application Solutions Architect
positions.description: I led teams of engineers at one of the premier brands in retail. We embraced future looking technology and used it to further differentiate and enhance the customer experience. Look for us on the web, and your mobile devices.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: At Starbucks, I had the pleasure of working with very talented development and delivery teams. Together we implemented a new customer rewards system as part of a broader services oriented architecture and a new unified global web platform that was part of the Starbucks 40th year anniversary ceremony.
